title: PT round-03, 2024 Registration Form
bodyHtml:
IPC is going to conduct PT round 03, 2024 in IR & Chromatographic Purity by HPLC in Chemical Discipline (Drugs & Pharmaceuticals).

Note: The last date of participation has been extended to 08th December 2024.

You are requested to find the attached Registration form and send your consent with filled registration form on e-mail at qualityassurance-ipc@gov.in on or before 08th Dec 2024.

Please click to view Registration Form.PDF (opens in a new tab)
